name: Called By God
overview: Scripture reveals that being called by God is a divine initiative rooted in His sovereign knowledge and purpose, as seen when God personally called Moses from the burning bush and ordained Jeremiah as a prophet before his birth. This calling involves a response of willingness, exemplified by Isaiah's readiness to serve when God asked, 'Whom shall I send?' Jesus teaches that no one comes to Him unless drawn by the Father, emphasizing that believers are chosen and appointed by God to bear lasting fruit. While many are called, only those who respond in faith are chosen, highlighting the gracious and purposeful nature of God's call.
